subject: Add master password feature with startup unlock, hint, and settings migration
body:
Add master password feature with startup unlock, hint, and settings migration

- Add MasterPasswordService: verifier-based authentication, encrypted settings migration
- Add StartupUnlockService: prompts for master password and connection file password at startup
- Add XmlKeyValidator: validates encryption keys for connection/credential files
- Add MasterPasswordManager form: set/change/remove master password with optional hint
- Add OptionsSecurityPage.Extensions: MasterPasswordVerifier and MasterPasswordHint settings
- Update Runtime: master password session management, encryption key hierarchy
- Update frmMain: call StartupUnlockService before loading connections
- Update ToolsMenu: add Master Password menu item
- Update XmlConnectionsDecryptor: integrate with Runtime encryption key
- Update ConnectionInfoPropertyGrid: sync encryption key on root node password change
- Update FrmPassword/MiscTools: add IWin32Window overloads for parent window association
- Add 18 localization strings to Language.resx and Language.Designer.cs
- Add XmlKeyValidatorTests (9 unit tests)
- Add MASTER_PASSWORD_FEATURE.md documentation
- Update CHANGELOG.md
- Fix mRemoteNG.csproj: conditional TextTemplating import and AxMSTSCLib for CLI builds
